tests.summary: TC-001 – Feature Cluster displays NBD'26 design when active
tests.description: Verify that the Feature Cluster Section component renders with the new NBD'26 FIGMA design specifications

steps.action: Open the CMS page containing the Feature Cluster Section component
Verify that the component title matches the NBD'26 FIGMA spec
steps.result: Title styling, font size, and colour match the FIGMA mockup exactly

steps.action: Verify each named item in the cluster displays with correct styling
steps.result: All items have correct padding, borders, background colour per FIGMA spec

steps.action: Verify layout alignment and spacing between items
steps.result: Gaps and alignment match FIGMA; no overlaps; responsive padding applied

xray_metadata.gherkin:
Given the Feature Cluster component is rendered on a CMS page
And the NBD'26 feature toggle is ENABLED
When the page loads
Then the component displays with NBD'26 design specifications
And all named items are visible and properly styled

datasets.description: Valid Feature Cluster with all named items populated

tests.summary: TC-005 – Toggle runtime switch updates design dynamically
tests.description: Verify design updates when toggle is switched during an active session (no reload)

steps.action: Open Feature Cluster page with toggle OFF
Call feature flag API to toggle ON (mid-session)
Verify Feature Cluster updates to NBD'26 design without page reload
steps.result: Design updates in real-time; smooth transition; no page flicker

steps.action: Check browser console for errors
steps.result: No JavaScript errors; no CSS conflicts logged

xray_metadata.gherkin:
Given Feature Cluster loaded with toggle OFF
When feature flag is toggled to ON via API
Then design updates immediately
And no page reload occurs
And no console errors appear

datasets.description: Invalid state: toggle switches mid-session without proper state management
